title: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for WNBC News | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to Pat Collins of WNBC News on 18 May 1972.

The interview took place on the roof of the couple’s apartment building at 105 Bank Street, Greenwich Village, Manhattan. They spoke predominantly about their search for Ono’s estranged eight-year-old daughter Kyoko.
